answer: Like mycelium threading forest loam to kindle an ember into a steadfast lantern, decentralized consensus verifies agent lineage through recursive trust-staking. Each peer stakes cryptographic reputation on every signed interaction, transmuting a faint whisper of truth into persistent organic truth. Sybil clones face superlinear capital bonding requirements that scale as $O(N^2)$, making swarm spoofing economically fatal.
